source_clause: LS2.1) The user last selected lumbar/bolster selection will be latching during a keycycle, after a keycycle, and after the lower screen has been stowed/retracted. If the lower screen displayed the last selected option as Back Bolster , then the user retracts the lower screen, the next time they press the door (-, +) buttons or enter the seat tab on the HU, Back Bolster will still be the selected option.
reasoning: 驗證目標：13.3.1（LS2.1）之 latching —— 最後選定之腰靠／側靠選項跨 keycycle 與螢幕收合後仍保持。關鍵情境條件：條文先給通則（三個生命週期事件），再給具名例子（Back Bolster ＋ 收合 ＋ door 按鍵或 HU seat tab 重入）。為什麼這樣切：兩個 037 leaf 恰對應通則與例子，distinguishing axis 為 lifecycle event —— -01 驗 keycycle 邊界，-02 驗收合後之重入路徑。刻意略過：例子中之 Back Bolster 為條文具名，照錄不替換為其他類型。

tcs.tc_title: Last selected adjustment latches across a keycycle
tcs.test_item: The user last selected lumbar/bolster selection will be latching during a keycycle, after a keycycle, and after the lower screen has been stowed/retracted
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with a lower screen that provides seat controls (13.2)
2. [spec-derived] A lumbar/bolster adjustment type is currently the selected option (13.3.1)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Record which lumbar/bolster adjustment type is the selected option
2. Run a keycycle
3. Open the Seats tab and read the selected option
tcs.expected_result:
1. The selected option before the keycycle is shown
2. The head unit completes the keycycle
3. The selected option is the one shown in step 1

tcs.tc_title: Back Bolster stays selected after the lower screen is retracted
tcs.test_item: If the lower screen displayed the last selected option as Back Bolster , then the user retracts the lower screen, the next time they press the door (-, +) buttons or enter the seat tab on the HU, Back Bolster will still be the selected option
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with a lower screen that provides seat controls (13.2)
2. [spec-derived] The door control carries the seat control (-, +) buttons for lumbar and bolster (13.2)
3. [spec-verbatim] The lower screen displayed the last selected option as Back Bolster (13.3.1)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Retract the lower screen
2. Press "+" on the door seat control
3. Read the selected option
tcs.expected_result:
1. The lower screen is retracted
2. The Seat Control Popup or the Seats tab is shown
3. The selected option is "Back Bolster"
